theme_strategy: Hybrid approach. Mobile App (Technician): Light theme forced for maximum outdoor visibility. Desktop Dashboard (Supervisor): Light theme default with dark mode optional for heavy data tables. Use 'The Performance Pro' (Industrial Variant) archetype.

rules: No Inter or generic sans for headings.
H1 max size is text-4xl on mobile, text-5xl on desktop. Ensure tracking-tight for all headings over 32px.
Labels/Overlines must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use IBM Plex Sans for tables, inputs, and checklist items to ensure technical legibility.
Tinted grey rule: no pure black or #808080. Use Slate/blue-grey tones (e.g. Slate-900 for text).
High contrast for field visibility. Text contrast must pass APCA.
Never use teal green or teal blue for dashboards.
Limit the use of primary colors to CTAs. Color in checklists should only be used to indicate status (Judgment marks).

layouts.mobile_app: Mobile-first responsive. Full width with p-4 or p-6 padding. Large tap targets (min 48px height) for checklist judgment marks. Optical alignment for icons.
layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6). Tight gap (gap-4). Data correlation prioritized.
rules: Avoid centering everything. Left align forms, labels, and checklists.
Use cardless, sharp edge or max 8px radius styles for dashboard widgets.
Use subgrid or flex for complex list items to maintain alignment across checklist rows.

surfaces.forms: Flat Solid surfaces. NO glassmorphism to prevent visual refraction outdoors.
surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift.
surfaces.headers: Solid background with hard bottom border. Never fully transparent.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions on hover, click, press. Smooth transitions for checklist section expansion/collapse.
rules: Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).

component_instructions.checklist_item: Custom component. Row layout with sequence number, description, location. Below it, a 4-segment toggle for Judgments (✔ Good, ◎ Replaced/Adjusted, ✖ Damage, ▬ None). Must be fat-finger friendly.
component_instructions.photo_upload: Use Shadcn customized components. Needs a prominent, easy-to-tap area for taking/uploading multiple point photos per checkpoint.
component_instructions.signatures: Digital signature canvas component required at the end of the form for 4 roles.
component_instructions.pdf_export: Prominent action button on the detail view to generate the official Fujitec SIR report.
component_instructions.data_tables: Use Shadcn Table for Supervisor dashboard. Dense, sortable columns for tracking PO, Inventory, and Maintenance follow-ups.
component_instructions.tabs: Use Shadcn tabs for switching between the 6 checklist sections (Elevator Operation, Motor Room, Car, Hoistway, Pit, Others).

icons.usage: Use Phosphor Icons for dense dashboards and industrial tooling, providing a crisp, technical look.

image_urls.description: Technician in hard hat inspecting equipment. Use for login page or onboarding background.
Dark analytics dashboard. Use for supervisor login or empty state visuals.

accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements, toggles, signature pads, and form inputs MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='login-button', data-testid='checklist-item-1').
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all form inputs and checklist toggles.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make this UI distinctive, functional, and industrial-grade.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or sticky headers.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep forms flat and highly readable.
Prioritize Shadcn components customized with Tailwind.
Ensure the layout doesn't break on mobile (crucial for field technicians).
Include logic or UI for the 1M, 3M, 12M checklist type selection leading to dynamic forms.
